mentions.name: Blackboard — stackable interactive teaching slides
mentions.description: Educators teaching numerical methods and operational research; students who view the slides in class.
mentions.audience: A set of interactive slides for teaching numerical methods and operational research. Users pick the slides they want and arrange them into a sequence directly in the URL, so there is no registration, no user data collection, and no persistent state. Planned additions include a convenient sequence constructor, a blank slide for displaying custom content, and a similar quiz page. Some slides have already been used for teaching and students seem to like them.
